name: Seeed XIAO ePaper EE04 (7.5" mono)
description: Seeed XIAO ePaper Display Board EE04 (XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus) driving the 7.5 inch monochrome panel on the 24-pin FPC (800x480). Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API and paints a raw 1-bpp mono buffer (48000 bytes) produced by the esp32_bw_bin renderer; byte-identical wire contract to the Seeed reTerminal E1001 and the XIAO ePaper 7.5. Reports battery percentage via the onboard ADC divider and carries the refresh/left/right three-button set like the EE02; no onboard temperature/humidity sensor.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware; community bring-up in progress. Wire format is exactly 48000 bytes (800*480/8), MSB=leftmost pixel, bit-set=white, bit-clear=black; no header, no padding, no checksum. Frame is byte-identical to the seeed_reterminal_e1001 and xiao_epaper_75 targets, so validate cross-panel by pointing the same renderer output at any of them. Default device ids look like Seeed_EE04_75_<mac-suffix>. The board hosts one panel on either a 24-pin or 50-pin FPC; this kind is the 24-pin mono build variant, see seeed_ee04_73e6 for the 50-pin Spectra 6 variant.
